listed-building demolition can require listed-building consent
scheduled-monument works can require scheduled-monument consent
building-control demolition notice duties are distinct from planning
demolition status does not establish ownership redevelopment permission or final yield
core_rules: Part11 PD is not unrestricted demolition
prior approval is not full planning permission
planning demolition right does not replace LBC
planning demolition right does not replace SMC
building-control notice is not planning approval
demolition permission is not redevelopment permission
prior approval matter scope is limited
site notice compliance must be evidenced
demolition does not establish future use
demolition does not prove contamination clearance
no parcel demolition clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
